name: [Č] Karlovy Vary - Kadaň
description_md:
It spans a distance of 59.1 km with 1604 m of ascent and 1695 m of descent. This hard route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as 0244. Walkers can expect a walking time of about 19 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The trail passes Market Colonnade within 100 m, Castle Spa within 100 m, and Castle Colonnade within 200 m.
